references.text: Refers to the Feast of Unleavened Bread in the month of Abib, when Israel left Egypt
Repeats the commandment about the Feast of Unleavened Bread in the month of Abib and mentions the departure from Egypt
Reminder to keep Passover in the month of Abib because the Lord brought the people out of Egypt by night
God establishes this month as the first month of the year for Israel
Describes the day when the Lord led the Israelites out of Egypt
States that Israel broke camp from Rameses in the first month, the day after Passover
Creates a theological contrast between the saving departure (Abib) and the condemned retreat into the wilderness.
